question: Does sharing the plate (longer layer time) make v58's face rougher?
hypothesis: E-001's v58 strip shared the plate with a second strip, so each layer took about 35 s; E-002's strip printed alone at about 18 s per layer and came out much smoother, with nothing else changed. With matte PLA at full fan, a longer wait lets each layer cool fully, so layer boundaries show.
prediction: Two v58 strips on one plate both come out like E-001's (rougher than E-002's lone strip).
why_this_test: E-002 changed nothing deliberately (no drying, no calibration), so the one difference from E-001 is the plate: one object or two. A full tile's cross-section matches the strip's, so this is also 'one pair per plate or two'.

controlled.filament: Kexcelled K5 PLA M, Light Matte Terracotta (lot C6719062), same spool, not dried
